messages:
sara: Heads-up — spotted a 404 in the onboarding runbook when clicking the `DB migration` shortlink. Found in /handbook/runbooks/onboarding.md around line ~120. Shortlink is https://rwd.link/dbmigrate -> 404. anyone owns this? @ben? :eyes:

ben: I used to maintain that runbook, might be my old shortlink. I'll take a look in a few. If it's just a shortlink swap we can rehost or replace with canonical S3 path.

natalie: Is this user-facing or internal? if external we should hotfix, internal can wait for next docs sprint. Any repro steps?

sara: internal-only, but it's referenced by the onboarding checklist (so blocks a few new hires). repro: open onboarding checklist -> click "DB migration" action -> 404. quick curl: `curl -I https://rwd.link/dbmigrate`

ben: running curl now... returns 404. I can open a tiny PR replacing the shortlink with `https://kb.redwood.ai/runbooks/db-migration.md`. putting it in my queue.

ben: created PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7324 — swap shortlink and add redirect note. tagging @natalie for quick review.

natalie: On it, will review in 30. can we include a one-line redirect in Netlify `_redirects` to avoid breaking any external references? also add a tiny changelog line.

link-bot: Automated: link-scan found 1 broken shortlink in onboarding.md (severity: low). Ticket created #DOCS-1182.

sara: thanks all. @ben if you can add the redirect and changelog note i'm happy to merge once @natalie gives LGTM.

ben: will do, ETA ~1h. :thumbsup: 

natalie: LGTM after minor nit (use absolute path in redirect). merge + deploy when green.

sara: merged and deployed. site shows 200 for both curl and browser. closing thread. :tada:
